أنغمس (form VII)
# أَنْغَمِسُ (ʔanḡamisu) /ʔan.ɣa.mi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
# أَنْغَمِسَ (ʔanḡamisa) /ʔan.ɣa.mi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
# أَنْغَمِسْ (ʔanḡamis) /ʔan.ɣa.mis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
